newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Nov reserve money within c.bank target.
newsitem.headline: Polish Nov reserve money within c.bank target.

text.p: Polish November reserve money amounted to 33.541 billion zlotys, within the National Bank of Poland's target range set earlier between 33.29 and 33.99 billion, the central bank said in a statement.
October's average daily reserve money was 32.997 billion zlotys, within a target of 32.95 to 33.65 billion.
The central bank last month set the target for December between 34.43 and 35.13 billion zlotys.
Reserve money, also called high powered money or monetary base, consists of cash in circulation, cash in vaults and obligatory reserves.

A NBP senior official said on Tuesday the central bank would not publish its reserve money target for January 1997 because the lower house of parliament has not yet passed the central bank's 1997 monetary policy outline.
Since January 1996, it has served as the central banks' monetary policy operational target, through which it wants to control money supply growth and inflation.
